title: Odissi music: follow the singer
coverage_gap: Research map and KB queried for Odissi music. Existing dance and people records reused; no dedicated Sounds vocal story found. This article adds vocal curriculum, repertoire and preservation evidence without duplicating a dance biography.

sources.title: Utkal University of Culture — Odissi Vocal syllabus, 2023–24
sources.locator: Cover and PDF pp.4–6 (printed pp.1–3): MPA101–105, repertoire, notation and practical papers. Approved in 2023, effective from 2023–24. PDF text inspected and cover/page 4 visually checked; this is dated curriculum evidence, not confirmation of current admissions.

sources.title: Sangeet Natak Akademi — dance award register
sources.locator: 1976 entry for Sanjukta Panigrahi, explicitly a joint award with Raghunath Panigrahi for Odissi music. Indexed register text inspected; direct web retrieval failed. Existing KB source identity reused.

sources.title: Bijayini Satpathy — ABHIPSAA, A Seeking (2021)
sources.locator: Music credits, item 2: Virahī, in longing. Production page read directly; credits describe this work, not every Odissi performance. Existing Mardala source identity reused.

sources.title: Guru Kelu Charan Mohapatra Odissi Research Centre — RTI handbook
sources.locator: Manual 1: opening, The Archive, Publications; Books & Cassettes. Describes July 1986 establishment, Champu publications and notations. Undated institutional account read directly; relative dates and present availability are not relied upon.

claim_boundaries: Vocal music is distinct from the dance while connected to it. No claim of a single origin or uninterrupted ancient continuity.
Syllabus repertoire is attributed to the dated curriculum, not an exhaustive classification or a current admission offer.
Joint-award year is recognition, not origin or recording date.
Poet, composer, singer, arranger, rhythm musician and choreographer remain distinct.
Institutional preservation accounts do not establish online access, recording rights or current purchase availability.
No lyrics, translations, audio or source images republished.
future_research: Read specific historical editions with a specialist before building a longer chronology.
